name: War & Romance
source:
War & Romance Visual Novel, is a historical fiction story based on Medieval Egypt and Middle East.

It's an adventure of noble warriors at the time of tyranny and slavery. A love story during brutal war times in a world full of conflict.

The story is deep, with plot twists and based on historical true events, with different themes. A beautiful War & Romance thriller. You will go through historical battles between pharaohs, Persians, Arabs, Muslims and Byzantines. You will enjoy with our characters like a Byzantine noble fighting to save the girl he loves, an Egyptian girl escaping from an oppressive military rule, a noble warrior that goes above the standard of his time....

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/New-Nintendo-3DS-Download-Software/War-Romance-Visual-Novel-1740826.html#Overview/]Nintendo store game page[/url]]
translation:
战争与浪漫视觉小说，是一部以中世纪埃及和中东为背景的历史小说故事。

这是暴政和奴隶制时期高贵战士的冒险。这是一个发生在充满冲突的世界的残酷战争时期的爱情故事。

故事深刻，情节曲折，取材于历史真实事件，题材各异。一部美丽的战争与浪漫惊悚片。你将经历法老、波斯人、阿拉伯人、穆斯林和拜占庭人之间的历史战争。你将享受我们的角色，例如为拯救他所爱的女孩而战的拜占庭贵族、逃离压迫性军事统治的埃及女孩、超越时代标准的高贵战士……
